currentEtLStatus.advisoryStatus: Rhode Island now has parser-backed same-key President-versus-U.S.-Senate review rows. Advisory indicators are source-review calculations only, not findings.

certifiedResults.caveat: The raw technical ZIP is below posted statewide JSON by 32 President votes, so normalized certified rows include an explicit non-geographic reconciliation delta rather than silently changing precinct rows. The native importer aggregates official city/town rows to five county rows for the production result map; Federal Precincts and the reconciliation delta remain non-geographic and are not mapped.

sameGrainComparisonContest.preferredContest: U.S. Senate, same official 2024 General Election long-format ZIP source family as President.
sameGrainComparisonContest.caveat: U.S. Senate is the preferred statewide comparison contest. The raw ZIP U.S. Senate rows are 29 votes below posted statewide JSON, and presidential-only rows are not paired into review rows.
